from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from one judgment document for matching to a specific result."""
    document_label: str | None = Field(description="Identifier for the document in the collection (e.g., '判决文书1')")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The specific case citation number found in the document (e.g., (2023) 辽 0211 民初 12741 号)")
    parties: list[str] = Field(description="List of key parties named (appellants, appellees, victims, etc.)")
    dispute_category: str | None = Field(description="The type of dispute described (e.g., property damage, construction contract, execution objection)")
    court_disposition: str | None = Field(description="The general disposition of the court (e.g., 'Sustain original judgment', 'Revoke order', 'Dismiss appeal')")
    ruling_specifics: list[str] = Field(description="Specific unique details in the ruling (e.g., amounts like '18,550 yuan', revoked case numbers, names of people in appeal)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
